features.name: Hold-to-reveal floating button
features.description: Pressing and holding Option for 300ms shows a small circular owl button near the cursor. Clicking it opens the existing rewrite popup. Extends HotkeyEventTap with keyUp events and adds OptionHoldDetector, FloatingButtonController, and FloatingButtonView.
features.evidence: All 89 tests pass including 7 new OptionHoldDetectorTests. Build clean. New files: OptionHoldDetector.swift, FloatingButtonController.swift, FloatingButtonView.swift, OptionHoldDetectorTests.swift. Modified: HotkeyEventTap.swift (keyUp support), OwletApp.swift (wiring). BUGFIX 2026-05-29: feature never fired in-app — bare Option emits CGEventType.flagsChanged, not keyDown/keyUp, which were absent from the event-tap mask. Added .flagsChanged to mask and routed Option-hold start/cancel through transition detection (HotkeyEventTap.decideModifierAction). 101/101 tests pass incl. 7 new HotkeyEventTapTests. MANUAL VERIFY PENDING: hold Option ~300ms in any text field → owl button appears.

features.name: Screenshot-based rewrite via double-click Option
features.description: Double-tap Shift to capture a screen region, send to a local vision model (default llava:7b), and show rewritten text in popup. Adds RegionSelectorController, ScreenshotCapturer, VisionClient, and extends HotkeyEventTap with double-tap detection. Trigger changed from double-click Option to double-tap Shift (commit 668f6e6); vision model changed from qwen2.5-vl to llava:7b (commit 52f8cfd).
features.evidence: All 94 tests pass including 5 new VisionClientTests. Build clean. New files: VisionClient.swift, VisionClientTests.swift, ScreenshotCapturer.swift, RegionSelectorController.swift, RegionSelectorOverlayView.swift. Modified: HotkeyEventTap.swift (double-click), RewriterFlow.swift (startFromScreenshot), PopupState.swift (.loadingScreenshot, .noTextInImage), Preferences.swift (visionModel), OwletApp.swift (wiring), ImprovePromptFloater.swift (loadingScreenshot rendering). BUGFIX 2026-05-29: double-tap trigger (now Shift, commit 668f6e6) never fired in-app — bare Shift emits CGEventType.flagsChanged, not keyDown, so detection in the keyDown branch was unreachable. Added .flagsChanged to event-tap mask; double-tap now detected via absent->present Shift transitions in HotkeyEventTap.decideModifierAction. 101/101 tests pass incl. 7 new HotkeyEventTapTests. MANUAL VERIFY PENDING: double-tap Shift → region selector opens. REWORK 2026-05-29: region selector overhauled — SwiftUI DragGesture (no onEnded; drags never completed) replaced with AppKit RegionSelectorView on a single union-of-all-screens RegionSelectorPanel (canBecomeKey). Adds: drag-to-select, Esc/right-click/click-without-drag to cancel, only-active-screen dim that follows the cursor, re-trigger toggles closed. ScreenshotCapturer now Retina/multi-display aware via unit-tested pixelCropRect. Removed Views/RegionSelectorOverlayView.swift. 105/105 tests pass (4 new ScreenshotCapturerTests). Rewrote to one overlay window per NSScreen (screen-local coords, acceptsFirstMouse for drags on non-key screens, only cursor's screen dims, Esc via local+global NSEvent monitors removed in dismiss()). selectRegion() contract unchanged; ScreenshotCapturer + 4 tests untouched. 105/105 tests pass.
